generation.scope: A point can never have both a predecessor line and a successor line. Its hypothetical unique self-block extends over a two-dimensional first-order base of simultaneous rank-two deformations. Three scalar equations suffice to close two moving boundaries between fixed endpoints, giving a nonconstant infinitesimal loop and exponential growth.

open_mathematics: Analyze one-sided isolated centers through their rational normal successors and the finite point strata beyond the existing symmetry tests.
